name: 16k-ultra-realistic-flash-selfie
image_purpose: Social profile visual and bedroom lifestyle post

prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-realistic vertical close-up selfie of an approved adult in a lived-in poster-lined bedroom, preserving the long ash-brown hair, black T-shirt, phone flash, and pink-purple LED ambience.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with very long thick ash-brown soft waves, center-parted curtain bangs, decorative clips at the temples, natural pores and imperfections, holding a smartphone with one hand and wearing a black matte cotton T-shirt.
prompt.composition_elements: Eye-level first-person close-up selfie with arm extended, visible phone grip and flash, bedroom corner with movie and music posters, wall art, and LED strips. Keep supplied poster graphics as background references only. Vertical 9:16 framing.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Direct smartphone flash creates high-contrast facial highlights while hot pink, deep purple, and violet LED strips add colorful rim light and moody background wash. Fine digital sensor noise and realistic skin texture.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone main-camera look, 24mm equivalent, vertical 9:16, flash-enabled portrait, individual hair strands, natural digital noise, realistic handheld framing.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-realistic vertical 9:16 close-up selfie of an approved adult woman with very long thick ash-brown soft waves, center-parted curtain bangs, decorative clips at the temples, natural pores and imperfections, holding a smartphone with one hand and wearing a black matte cotton T-shirt. Bedroom corner with supplied movie and music posters, wall art, and LED strips. Direct smartphone flash creates crisp facial highlights while hot pink, deep purple, and violet LEDs add colorful rim light and a moody Gen-Z background wash.
